title: Ordinary two-point correlations of multiplicative functions
main_claim: (1) For fixed nonproportional affine forms, the sum over n<=X of lambda(a1 n+b1) lambda(a2 n+b2) is O(X/(log X)^c), with c>0 absolute, at every cutoff X. This includes ordinary two-point Chowla. (2) Binary corrected Elliott for ordinary averages: if at least one of f1, f2 (complex, 1-bounded, multiplicative) is uniformly nonpretentious, then (1/N) sum f1(n+h1) f2(n+h2) -> 0. Affine and progression versions are also claimed.

issues.description: The truncated inclusion-exclusion uses moduli r <= y^{r_0} = exp(O(L^{0.99} log L)). It needs r <= D and a boundary error (1/D)exp(O(L^{0.99} log L)) = o(L^{-K}), with D >= exp(L^{0.995})/2. That requires L^{0.005} >> 1000 log L, i.e. roughly L > e^{3000}. This is valid as an asymptotic statement ('sufficiently large L'), so it is not a gap. It does make the threshold, and so the implied constants, astronomically large and ineffective, which the paper acknowledges.
issues.evidence: 'Its normalized count ... differs from this density by O(r/D) when r<=D ... each with r<=y^{r_0}. The total boundary error is therefore at most (1/D)exp(O(L^{0.99}log L))'

coverage:
Read all of Part I (01-08) closely, checking these steps:
- Parameters and prime-mass computations: V_i = 3W/2; the Markov bounds in Lemma q:bin-mass.
- Finite-law lemma: bit encoding, CRT total-variation bound, Fourier correction to exact t-wise independence, and the Braverman parameter chain (A > C1+20).
- Centering: rough-number sieve, fourth moment, the MRT Thm 1.3 application, frequency split exponents (L^{-1.05} and L^{-1.55}), and the substitution n = q d' v in every residue class.
- Padding anti-concentration: characteristic-function exponent 6/5.
- Deletion costs: the exponential-Markov constants for the Q-degree and P-degree cuts.
- Self-adjoint transfer lemma: checked the resolvent argument fully.
- Weighted Schur and AM-GM row bounds, and the C3 choice.
- Block-averaging multiplicity m_N.
- Witness definition, density, and the active-label lemma.
- Rank probability lemma and the singleton elimination ordering.
- Perfect-block geometry and the forest code: acyclicity, non-backtracking decoding, code-count exponents.
- Padding-sum lemma and the final trace and constant bookkeeping, including the exponent c = delta/(6WA).
- Affine identity.

Part II: read the setup, the absolute-defect lemma, the raw-bin and raw-lower-bound lemmas (constants gamma/8), the whole analytic centering section (MRT Thm 1.7 uniformity under finite prime twists, rough multiplier bounds, frequency split giving B^{-2+10eps}), and the full localization section (singular-value moment, exceptional blocks, discarded edges, bilinear bound). Sanity-checked the graph estimate against F=G=1 with adversarial divisor families; this is consistent with the B^{-1-c*/2} claim.

Only skimmed paths.tex, thinning.tex, cylinder-sieve.tex and most of trace-count.tex (first ~320 lines read: subtree identity, token records, start of primewise integration). Those deep combinatorial sections of Part II were not fully verified. Part III affine corollaries for general f were not read beyond the introduction.
